records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Works!
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for setting up Quartz Works on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Project created day 4 (facts), so some real usage, but no invite sent and zero replies to either outreach ([email:39a391a6], [email:ebd4564c]), no tickets. Solo Starter accounts that go quiet rarely hit the key milestone in 8 remaining days unaided, though the first-project step keeps it above negligible.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Nice work getting Quartz Works' first project set up last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a teammate is usually what makes the shared work click — you can invite one from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through who to bring in first and how you'd like the work split up.

Best,
Nadia
